Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly fixed on Hillcrest High School in Country Club Hills, Illinois as the “relevant” school. The task hinges on the city name; there is a Hillcrest High School in Springfield, Missouri, and the screenwriter (Margaret Mayo) was born in Illinois—so the city to evaluate is “Springfield” becoming Illinois’ capital (1839). By selecting the Illinois Hillcrest HS instead of the Springfield, MO one, the Planner misaligned the reasoning and led the solution off-track.
